exposure: APGAR score at the fifth minute (4 to 6)
cohort: The study included 689 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit in public hospitals in Hadiya Zone, Ethiopia.
finding: The incidence rate of early neonatal mortality was 16.9 deaths per 1000 person-days, with birth weight, APGAR score at the fifth minute, hypoglycemia, lack of oxygen treatment, and obstetric complications being significant predictors.
followup_time: Early neonatal period (typically 0-7 days after birth)
